## SKIN INFORMATION

This skin was originally posted [online](https://danmuji2box.tistory.com/804) and was broken so I fixed it, added ice wings, created the alt version, changed VFX colors and reuploaded it.
There are two versions of the skin available to download:

- Frozen Elsa Morgana - Classic
- Base Morgana = White Ice Wings
- Exiled Morgana = White Ice Wings
- Frozen Elsa Morgana - Classic Alt
- Base Morgana = Dark Ice Wings
- Exiled Morgana = Dark Ice Wings
